in_hebrew.name: Bannerman
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bearer of a banner
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bannerman הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from Old English ‘bannerman’, meaning ‘bearer of a banner’. Historically used for knights and soldiers who carried their leader's flag into battle.

in_greek.name: Bannerman
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bearer of a banner
in_greek.long_meaning: Bannerman είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from Old English ‘bannerman’, meaning ‘bearer of a banner’. Historically used for knights and soldiers who carried their leader's flag into battle.

in_latin.name: Bannerman
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bearer of a banner
in_latin.long_meaning: Bannerman est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from Old English ‘bannerman’, meaning ‘bearer of a banner’. Historically used for knights and soldiers who carried their leader's flag into battle.
